title: SGE: Semantically-Guided Exploration for Unstructured Environments via Image-Space Waypoint Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2608.29315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work introduces Semantically-Guided Exploration (SGE), a modular exploration framework for ground vehicles that integrates pixel-level semantic segmentation into sampling-based waypoint selection and receding-horizon route optimization. Unlike conventional geometric exploration methods, SGE evaluates candidate exploration goals directly in the image space using a semantic-aware utility function that accounts for terrain traversability, obstacle proximity, objects of interest, and depth-based exploration reward. Sampled waypoints are projected into 3D and ordered through a real-time Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) formulation, enabling receding-horizon goal selection. To address real-world navigation uncertainty, the framework introduces mechanisms, including temporary taboo regions to handle navigation failures and a graph-based relocation strategy for efficient backtracking across explored areas. translated_title: SGE：基于图像空间路径点采样的非结构化环境语义引导探索
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了语义引导探索，这是一个面向地面车辆的模块化探索框架，将像素级语义分割集成到基于采样的路径点选择和滚动时域路径优化中。与传统的几何探索方法不同，SGE直接在图像空间中评估候选探索目标，使用一个语义感知的效用函数，该函数综合考虑了地形可通行性、障碍物邻近度、感兴趣物体以及基于深度的探索奖励。采样得到的路径点被投影到三维空间，并通过实时旅行商问题（TSP）建模进行排序，从而实现滚动时域的目标选择。为应对现实世界中的导航不确定性，该框架引入了多种机制，包括用于处理导航失败的临时禁忌区域，以及用于在已探索区域间高效回溯的基于图的重新定位策略。我们在标准化环境中对SGE进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出SGE框架，将像素级语义分割融入图像空间的路径点采样与滚动时域路径优化，实现地面车辆在非结构化环境中的语义引导自主探索，并通过临时禁忌区域和基于图的回溯机制应对真实世界的导航不确定性。
en_tdlr: SGE is a modular exploration framework that integrates pixel-level semantic segmentation into image-space waypoint sampling and receding-horizon route optimization for ground vehicles, featuring temporary taboo regions and a graph-based relocation strategy to handle real-world navigation uncertainties.
